A. Does recent evidence support the size of effect we assume: does this measure shorten the time from first symptom to treatment start for lung cancer patients, and by how many days?
Measure: Standardised lung cancer pathway with booked slots. A lung cancer pathway on the Danish/Swedish/Norwegian model: fixed referral criteria, pre-booked CT, PET-CT, bronchoscopy and MDT slots, a named pathway owner, and published time limits for each step.
effect_summary_en: The Swedish national study sets a 30–44 day lead time for its lung cancer pathway, but only 30% of patients started treatment within it; it reports no days saved compared with no pathway.
supported_en: Swedish national data (Scientific Reports 2023) give a lung cancer pathway lead time of 30–44 days, met by 30% of patients.
not_supported_en: No page read reports how many days a pathway saves; the assumed 14 days (range 5–23) is not tested.
in_use_quote: Keuhkosyövässä seurataan seuraavia hoitoonpääsyaikoja lähetteen saapumisesta Tyksin keuhkovastuualueelle.
in_use_summary_en: Tyks publishes its lung cancer waiting times, measured from the day a referral arrives (first contact 9 days, chemotherapy start 35 days on average in January–June 2025), and holds a weekly meeting where several specialties plan treatment; no page shows booked scan or bronchoscopy slots, a named pathway owner or time limits for each step.
missing_en: No page shows pre-booked CT, PET-CT or bronchoscopy slots, fixed referral criteria, a named pathway owner or published time limits for each step.
summary_en: Tyks publishes lung cancer waiting times, measured from the day a referral arrives: on average 9 days to first contact and 35 days to the start of chemotherapy in January–June 2025. It also holds a weekly meeting where several specialties plan treatment, but no page shows booked test slots, a pathway owner or time limits for each step. A Swedish national study (2023) shows that only 30% of lung cancer pathway patients met the 30–44 day lead time, and it reports no number of days saved.
unanswered_en: No page shows whether Tyks has booked slots for scans and bronchoscopy, and no study read reports how many days a lung cancer pathway saves.
